card: This PR cleans up legacy wallet leftovers in three functional test scripts: wallet_address_types.py, wallet_backup.py, and wallet_hd.py. It removes an unreachable and broken multisig code path left behind when legacy wallet tests were dropped, corrects an outdated docstring referencing dumpwallet/importwallet, and drops a redundant -keypool=0 option. It resolves technical debt and misleading comments in the test suite without altering test coverage.
evidence: Commit 164894d934 points out that `do_multisigs = [False]` rendered the multisig branch permanently unreachable following legacy wallet test removal in c847dee148, and notes the branch was broken anyway since fe838dd391 because it never set the address it checked.
PR description states that test coverage is unchanged, running the same 8 send iterations in `wallet_address_types.py` before and after.
problem: After legacy wallet support was removed from Bitcoin Core, wallet functional tests retained stale remnants. Developers reading these tests encounter misleading documentation, ineffective node configurations, and dead code paths.

risk.why: A mistake would only break functional test execution in the test runner.

scope_notes: Pure test cleanup across three functional test files.
summary: Removes dead code, unused parameters, and outdated comments leftover from legacy wallet support across three wallet functional tests. In `wallet_address_types.py`, it deletes an unreachable and broken multisig test loop; in `wallet_backup.py`, it updates the docstring to describe `backupwallet`/`restorewallet` instead of `dumpwallet`/`importwallet`; in `wallet_hd.py`, it removes a no-op `-keypool=0` argument.
